solutions.title: Prefix brute force
solutions.strategy: Build prefix balances and test every interval for equal start and end balance.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every pair of interval boundaries can be examined.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The prefix balance array stores n+1 values.

solutions.title: First balance index
solutions.strategy: Treat zero as -1 and one as +1; the same balance at two indices marks a balanced interval.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each number is processed once and each balance lookup is constant average time.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The map can store one first index for each distinct balance.
